method: Direct typed C reconstruction of the SG3 reader from the pinned executable's Ghidra pseudocode, using the previous project's translation as a cross-check. Absolute pixel-cursor state is represented as a per-call offset. Validation covers all installed SG3 files and their paired 555 data through the new reader.

groups.previous_source_notes: The prior body supplied the SG3 field behavior, but depends on LegacyBindings and writes the pixel cursor through absolute address 0x00D3B5F4; production code does neither.

verification.reason: The source-only harness loaded every installed .sg3 file with its paired .555 data; slot indices cycle through 0 to 29, exercising both system-image inclusion and exclusion.
